penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce Revenue Cloud / CPQ configuration work requires deep domain expertise per customer — each engagement involves custom rule logic that Claude cannot reliably deliver without a human Salesforce expert validating and deploying the output.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise CPQ customers will need iterative Q&A and troubleshooting that requires human judgement on Salesforce-specific edge cases.

rationale: The buyer is real and has budget — Salesforce Revenue Cloud admins at mid-market/enterprise companies are paid professionals whose employers spend heavily on Salesforce — but the solution cannot be built or delivered autonomously. Generating correct Business Rules Engine / Constraints Engine configuration requires hands-on Salesforce expertise to validate and deploy; Claude cannot reliably produce and ship production-safe CPQ logic without a human expert in the loop for every engagement. The operational_autonomy score (3) reflects this hard ceiling, which both disqualifies it from build and pulls the total well below the validate threshold after penalties.
solution_plan: No viable hands-off plan exists for a solo non-technical operator. This would require either a Salesforce-certified partner doing the actual configuration work (making it a consulting/done-for-you play with heavy human fulfillment) or a deep Salesforce integration that goes far beyond Claude prompts and a Stripe link. A Claude-generated 'template' for CPQ rules would need expert review before any customer could safely apply it in production. Youval could not build, sell, or maintain this without a Salesforce domain expert as a co-founder or subcontractor — at which point it is no longer a factory-compatible micro-service.
notes: Failing build gates: operational_autonomy (3 < 7 required), buildability_with_ai (4 < 6 required). Even before penalties, operational_autonomy and buildability floors are unmet. Post-penalty total of 2.7 is well below the 5.5 validate threshold. Drop.
